import random

def generate_test_case():
    # generate array length between 1 to 30000
    length = random.randint(1, 1000)
    # initiate the array with a random number between -100 to 100
    nums = [random.randint(-100, 100)]
    
    # generate the rest of the array
    for _ in range(length - 1):
        # each new number will be equal or larger than the last number, to ensure non-decreasing order
        nums.append(random.randint(nums[-1], 100))
    
    return nums
